info.title: Regent HR Management API
info.description: RESTful API for Regent College London Human Resource Management System. Supports Employee Lifecycle, Background Check Mock Integrations, HR Analytics, and Immutable Audit Trails.

get.description: Root landing endpoint providing quick links to interactive documentation and health diagnostics.

post.description: Authenticates user with email and password and returns a JWT bearer token.

get.description: Retrieves the profile of the currently authenticated user.

post.description: Creates a new application user (ADMIN only).

get.description: Lists application users (ADMIN only).

schema.title: Response List Users Api V1 Users Get

get.description: Retrieves a specific application user by ID (ADMIN only).

patch.description: Updates an application user's details, role, or active status (ADMIN only).

post.description: Creates a new organizational department (ADMIN only).

get.description: Lists departments (ADMIN, HR_OFFICER, VIEWER).

schema.title: Response List Departments Api V1 Departments Get

get.description: Retrieves department details by ID (ADMIN, HR_OFFICER, VIEWER).

delete.description: Deletes a department (ADMIN only, blocked if active employees exist).

post.description: Creates a new employee record (ADMIN and HR_OFFICER).

get.description: Paginated list of employees with search, multi-field filtering, and safe allowlisted sorting.

parameters.name: search

schema.description: Search by name, email or employee number
schema.title: Search

parameters.description: Search by name, email or employee number

parameters.name: sort_by

schema.description: Allowlisted sort field (id, employee_number, first_name, last_name, work_email, created_at, status)
schema.title: Sort By

parameters.description: Allowlisted sort field (id, employee_number, first_name, last_name, work_email, created_at, status)

get.description: Retrieves an employee record by ID (ADMIN, HR_OFFICER, VIEWER).

patch.description: Updates an employee record (ADMIN and HR_OFFICER).

delete.description: Deactivates an employee record (Soft Delete) to preserve auditability (ADMIN only).

post.description: Reactivates a deactivated employee record (ADMIN only). Returns 409 Conflict if already active.
Adds a new employment record for a specific employee (ADMIN and HR_OFFICER).

get.description: Lists all employment records for a specific employee (ADMIN, HR_OFFICER, VIEWER).

schema.title: Response List Employee Employment Records Api V1 Employees  Employee Id  Employment Records Get

get.description: Retrieves a specific employment record by ID (ADMIN, HR_OFFICER, VIEWER).

patch.description: Updates an existing employment record (ADMIN and HR_OFFICER).

post.description: Initiates a background check for an employee (ADMIN and HR_OFFICER).

get.description: Lists all background checks for an employee (Restricted notes filtered for VIEWER role).

schema.title: Response List Employee Background Checks Api V1 Employees  Employee Id  Background Checks Get

get.description: Retrieves specific background check details by ID (Restricted notes filtered for VIEWER role).

patch.description: Manually updates background check status or notes (ADMIN and HR_OFFICER).

post.description: Triggers mock external provider execution (DBS, Home Office, Credit, Bank) for controlled scenarios.

get.description: Retrieves high-level HR summary statistics (ADMIN and HR_OFFICER).
Retrieves active employee headcount breakdown grouped by department (ADMIN and HR_OFFICER).

schema.title: Response Get Headcount By Department Api V1 Reports Headcount By Department Get

get.description: Retrieves distribution of employee employment statuses (ADMIN and HR_OFFICER).

schema.title: Response Get Employment Status Report Api V1 Reports Employment Status Get

get.description: Retrieves list of pending, in-progress or review-required background checks (ADMIN and HR_OFFICER).

schema.title: Response Get Outstanding Checks Report Api V1 Reports Outstanding Checks Get

get.summary: Get Expiring Right To Work Report
get.description: Retrieves Right to Work checks expiring within specified days (ADMIN and HR_OFFICER).

schema.title: Response Get Expiring Right To Work Report Api V1 Reports Expiring Right To Work Get

get.description: Retrieves system audit log entries (ADMIN only, immutable read-only endpoint).
System health check endpoint.

schema.title: Response Health Check Api V1 Health Get

schema.title: Response Database Health Check Api V1 Health Database Get

get.description: API version endpoint.

schema.title: Response Version Check Api V1 Version Get

Database connectivity diagnostic endpoint.
